name: fontpool
description: Search Fontshare, Fontsource, Google and Bunny in one catalog, then download fonts into your project and write the @font-face rules.
long_description:
Gives Claude three tools for working with type: list_fonts to see every family available across the configured providers, font_properties to check a family's weights, styles and subsets, and install_font to download the actual woff2 files into a project folder and append the matching @font-face rules to a CSS file.

Fonts are self-hosted — no CDN request at runtime. Built on unifont.

Adobe Fonts is deliberately not included: Adobe's terms require their fonts be loaded from their own CDN via a kit embed, so they can't be downloaded into a project.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: Lists every font family available across the configured providers.

tools.name: font_properties
tools.description: Returns the weights, styles, subsets and serving provider for one family.

tools.name: install_font
tools.description: Downloads a family's woff2 files into the project and writes the CSS.
